classes.name: ShippingMethod
classes.description: Represents the shipping methods available in the checkout process, capable of retrieving and sorting shipping options based on extensions.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available shipping methods based on the given shipping address, loading extensions dynamically and sorting them by sort order.
